prompt:
Add a `tasklist` extension: a list item whose text starts with `[ ]`, `[x]` or `[X]` followed by a space becomes a task.
- The marker is replaced by `<input type="checkbox">`, `checked` for `x`/`X`, and `disabled` unless the `clickable` option is true (default false).
- The `<li>` gets the class from the `item_class` option (default `task`).
- It works in ordered and unordered lists, nested lists and loose lists, and keeps inline markup after the marker.
Register it so `markdown.Markdown(extensions=['tasklist'])` works once installed.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

+---
+title: Task Lists Extension
+---
+
+# Task Lists Extension
+
+The `tasklist` extension turns a list item beginning with `[ ]`, `[x]`, or
+`[X]` followed by a space into a checkbox. The `x` markers produce checked
+checkboxes. Both ordered and unordered lists, including nested and loose lists,
+are supported. Inline Markdown after the marker is processed as usual.
+
+```python
+markdown.markdown('- [x] **Done**', extensions=['tasklist'])
+```
+
+The checkbox is disabled by default. Set `clickable` to `True` to allow it to
+be clicked. The `item_class` option specifies the class added to the list item;
+it defaults to `task`. Set it to an empty string to add no class.
+
+```python
+markdown.markdown(text, extensions=['tasklist'], extension_configs={
+    'tasklist': {'clickable': True, 'item_class': 'todo'}
+})
+```

+"""Convert list items beginning with task markers into checkboxes."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as etree
+
+from . import Extension
+from ..treeprocessors import Treeprocessor
+
+
+class TasklistTreeprocessor(Treeprocessor):
+    """Insert checkboxes before inline processing of list item text."""
+
+    RE = re.compile(r'^\[([ xX])\] ')
+
+    def __init__(self, md, clickable, item_class):
+        super().__init__(md)
+        self.clickable = clickable
+        self.item_class = item_class
+
+    def run(self, root):
+        for parent in root.iter():
+            if parent.tag not in ('ul', 'ol'):
+                continue
+            for item in parent:
+                if item.tag != 'li':
+                    continue
+                target = item
+                if not item.text and len(item) and item[0].tag == 'p':
+                    target = item[0]
+                match = self.RE.match(target.text or '')
+                if not match:
+                    continue
+                checkbox = etree.Element('input', {'type': 'checkbox'})
+                if match.group(1).lower() == 'x':
+                    checkbox.set('checked', 'checked')
+                if not self.clickable:
+                    checkbox.set('disabled', 'disabled')
+                checkbox.tail = target.text[match.end():]
+                target.text = ''
+                target.insert(0, checkbox)
+                if self.item_class:
+                    item.set('class', ' '.join(filter(None, (item.get('class'), self.item_class))))
+
+
+class TasklistExtension(Extension):
+    """Add task list checkboxes to list items."""
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        self.config = {
+            'clickable': [False, 'Allow checkboxes to be clicked.'],
+            'item_class': ['task', 'Class added to task list items.']
+        }
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+
+    def extendMarkdown(self, md):
+        md.treeprocessors.register(
+            TasklistTreeprocessor(md, self.getConfig('clickable'), self.getConfig('item_class')),
+            'tasklist', 25
+        )
+
+
+def makeExtension(**kwargs):  # pragma: no cover
+    return TasklistExtension(**kwargs)

+"""Tests for the task list extension."""
+
+import unittest
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as etree
+
+import markdown
+
+
+class TestTasklist(unittest.TestCase):
+    def render(self, text, **options):
+        html = markdown.markdown(
+            text, extensions=['tasklist'], extension_configs={'tasklist': options}
+        )
+        return etree.fromstring('<root>' + html + '</root>')
+
+    def test_markers_and_inline_markup(self):
+        root = self.render('- [ ] *one*\n- [x] **two**\n- [X] [three](https://example.com)')
+        items = root.findall('./ul/li')
+        self.assertEqual([item.get('class') for item in items], ['task'] * 3)
+        for item in items:
+            self.assertEqual(item[0].attrib['type'], 'checkbox')
+            self.assertIn('disabled', item[0].attrib)
+        self.assertNotIn('checked', items[0][0].attrib)
+        self.assertIn('checked', items[1][0].attrib)
+        self.assertIn('checked', items[2][0].attrib)
+        self.assertEqual([item[1].tag for item in items], ['em', 'strong', 'a'])
+
+    def test_ordered_nested_and_loose_lists(self):
+        root = self.render('1. [x] first\n    - [ ] nested\n\n2. [ ] second\n\n   More text.')
+        items = root.findall('.//li')
+        self.assertEqual(len(items), 3)
+        self.assertTrue(all(item.get('class') == 'task' for item in items))
+        self.assertEqual(len(root.findall('.//input')), 3)
+        self.assertEqual(root.find('./ol/li/p/input').get('checked'), 'checked')
+        self.assertIn('More text.', ''.join(root.itertext()))
+
+    def test_options(self):
+        item = self.render('- [X] yes', clickable=True, item_class='todo').find('./ul/li')
+        self.assertEqual(item.get('class'), 'todo')
+        self.assertNotIn('disabled', item[0].attrib)
+        self.assertIn('checked', item[0].attrib)
+        self.assertIsNone(self.render('- [ ] yes', item_class='').find('./ul/li').get('class'))
+
+    def test_non_markers(self):
+        root = self.render('- [x]no\n- [y] no\n- text [x] later\n- `[x]` code\n\n[x] paragraph')
+        self.assertEqual(root.findall('.//input'), [])
+        self.assertEqual(root.findall('.//li[@class]'), [])
